title: Remove all emoji from app and docs; AGENTS.md rule: never use emojis
description: User directive: emojis are never acceptable in this project — Flash 8 (2005) had none and they break period accuracy. (1) Sweep all UI strings, panel labels, dialogs, alerts, tooltips, console messages, and docs for emoji/pictographs (grep by Unicode ranges) and replace with plain text or period-correct glyphs (checkmarks in menus are OK as ASCII/wingding-style only if Flash 8 used them — it used a checkmark glyph; keep the existing checkmark but verify rendering). (2) Add a rule to AGENTS.md: never use emojis anywhere — UI text, code comments, docs, task titles/descriptions, commit messages. (3) Optionally add a lint/grep check to pnpm verify to keep them out.
